This app will assist the MMO making mitigation decisions by calculating the distance from the animal to the source of acoustic interference using a trigonometric cosine function. Fix compass bearing to animal and source by pointing device and pressing button.

Set up to 3 unique observation locations to define height above sea level (required for accurate reticule conversion).
Save data to the log for each sighting and export in .csv format for your own mapping and analyses needs.
